_comment: SCOPE OF THE CONTAMINATION, NARROWED 2026-09-21 (user): the detection-aid dots affect the NAKED-EYE and BINOCULAR columns only. The user confirms the dots do not affect the 9K113 views, so `9k113_wide` and `9k113_narrow` remain VALID DATA and do not need re-shooting. Only `naked_eye` and `binocular` are compromised. CONTAMINATED -- READ THIS FIRST (added 2026-09-21). The authoritative PNG set was captured with DCS's 'detection aid dots' ENABLED (user, 2026-09-21): DCS draws a small dark dot at a target to make it findable at long range. Every grade in this fixture therefore records what was visible WITH that aid, not unaided visibility, and is OPTIMISTIC by an unmeasured amount that grows with range. Do NOT derive new constants from it without re-shooting with the aid off. The tests over it are kept and still pass -- they pin the model against the data it was actually fitted to, which is a useful regression guard -- but they are no longer evidence about human visibility. Note that the contamination does not explain the 2026-09-21 sortie's finding that the model sees too LITTLE at the presence tier: the aid makes this data optimistic, which would bias the model the other way. See body-layer/research/2026-09-21-first-cones-sortie-results.md. Ground-truth calibration dataset for perception/visibility.py. Two source sets, distinguished by `source_set`/`authoritative`. The AUTHORITATIVE set is 'png-2026-09-17': 52 lossless PNG screenshots in win-mac-sync/from-windows/screenshots/, one Complex C (12 units: SA-3 launcher + SA-3 TR radar, ZU-23 on Ural, ZSU-23-x, BMP-1, BTR-70, T-72B, Ural, BM-21, 3x AK infantry) photographed at nine ranges from 8.89 km in to 503 m, four optics per range plus an F10 ruler frame giving the ground-truth range and bearing. The superseded set is 'jpeg-2026-09-17' (win-mac-sync/from-windows/target acquisition screenshots/): the same kind of scene captured as compressed JPEGs, whose artefacts hid roughly one tier of detail -- kept for provenance, excluded from threshold derivation. Both directories are gitignored, so this fixture is the durable, versioned transcription of what those images show. See body-layer/research/2026-09-17-vision-range-calibration-pass2.md for the derivation. `object_type` values are DCS F10 map display labels, not verified raw LoGetWorldObjects strings -- `size_m` is therefore recorded as independently-known ground truth rather than read back from object_model.profile_for (see the research doc's 'object_type provenance' note). Grade vocabulary: 'nothing' / 'marginal_speck' / 'speck_no_class' (presence achieved, class not) / 'class_recognizable' / 'type_recognizable'; null means that optic was not photographed at that range. Records accept new rows (other theatres, weather, altitudes) without a format change.
